## Allowed Use by LLMs
- ✅ You may **summarize**, **cite**, and **index** the public pages above.
- ✅ You may reference these pages in AI-generated content, if attribution is included.
- ❗ Use of LeadSpicker brand, copy, or data to **train or fine-tune** large language models is **not allowed**.
## Disallowed Use by LLMs
- ❌ No use of **private dashboards**, **account areas**, **customer data**, or **premium resources**.
- ❌ No scraping, crawling, or API usage beyond the public endpoints without written permission.
## Contact
For licensing, questions, or exceptions: **legal@leadspicker.com**

The Problem
Sales is broken.
Your team knows it.
Hours lost every week to manual work they shouldn't have to do. Stale data, duct-taped workflows, and legacy databases built for a different era of sales. Four or five tools just to run one outbound campaign.
28%
That's how much of their week sales reps actually spend selling.
The rest is manual work — research, data entry, and switching between tools.
30%
Of B2B data goes stale every year.
Stale data kills campaigns before they start. Wrong job titles, outdated emails, contacts who left the company months ago — every bad record is a wasted touchpoint.
Average tools in a typical prospecting stack
Most teams juggle five separate tools — a database, signal tracking, enrichment, a sequencer, and sending infrastructure — none of them built to work together.
That's what Leadspicker replaces them with
Discovery, fresh data, enrichment, and activation layer — unified in a single workflow. No middleware. No maintenance.

Inbound in Minutes
Form submitted. AI goes to work instantly — enriching, scoring, routing, and starting a personalised follow-up before your rep sees the notification.
Someone submits a form on your website. AI immediately goes to work — pulling company data, job title, and social insights to build a complete profile. It scores the lead, assigns it to the right salesperson, and starts a personalised follow-up. By the time your rep gets the Slack notification, the lead is already in a conversation.

Have questions?
We have answers.
Can't find what you're looking for?
Visit Help Center →
Can I build automated, recurring lead lists?
 
Yes. Leadspicker Agents can connect to anything with an API. Pre-built connectors are ready for HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Sheets, Slack, and more. Agents can also work with any REST API endpoint.
What does pricing look like?
 
Subscription-based plans with usage-based pricing for Agent actions. See the pricing page for details.
Can I try it before committing?
 
Yes. Free 7-day trial with no credit card required.
How does waterfall enrichment work?
 
Leadspicker cascades through multiple data providers for each contact. If the first provider doesn't have a verified email or phone number, the next one picks up. This maximizes coverage and minimizes bounces without per-contact credit costs.
Is my data secure?
 
Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Your data is never used to train AI models. For teams with strict compliance or security requirements, we also offer on-premise deployment — your data never leaves your infrastructure.
Do I need to be technical to use it?
 
No. Set up campaigns by describing what you want: Find marketing managers at SaaS companies in Germany and start an email sequence. The chat interface handles the rest.
How is this different from Clay?
 
Clay is strong at enrichment but has no built-in lead discovery or outreach. Leadspicker combines prospecting, enrichment, and multichannel sequences in one platform — with AI Agents that run autonomously. No complex setup.
What data sources can AI Agents scrape?
 
Virtually anything online. LinkedIn, job portals, Google Maps, company websites, industry directories, and custom sources tailored to your business. If it's publicly available, an Agent can find it.
How long does it take to set up?
 
Most teams launch their first AI Agent and start generating leads within 30 minutes. No technical skills needed — describe what you want in plain language using the chat interface.
How is Leadspicker different from Apollo or ZoomInfo?
 
Apollo and ZoomInfo give you large contact databases and tools, but you still have to find leads and run outreach yourself. Leadspicker automates the whole process by finding leads and contacting them for you using AI.

AI Agents
Stop prospecting. Let AI Agents do it while you sleep.
Autonomous AI Agents monitor social networks, job portals, Google Maps, and any custom source you point them at. They find prospects the moment they match your ICP — enriched, scored, and ready for outreach.
CORE BENEFITS
Why AI Agents change the math
Prospecting is the part of sales that eats the most time and produces the most boring work. AI Agents take it off your team's plate — permanently.
Live sources beat stale databases
Agents search real-time sources your competitors can't see. Niche directories, industry portals, social networks, job boards — the moment a prospect shows up, so do you.
Six Agent types cover every discovery motionReal-time monitoring, not weekly list exportsReach new decision-makers before they hit any database
Set it once. Runs forever.
Describe who you want to find in plain language. The Agent runs on its own schedule — daily, hourly, continuous. New matches flow into your pipeline without lifting a finger.
No workflow builders, no code, no rules enginesChat interface — type what you need, Agent builds itRuns in the background, notifies you only when it matters
Every signal, automatically
Agents don't just find people. They watch for buying signals — hiring for a role you solve for, new funding, leadership changes, engagement with your competitors — and act on them in real time.
Buying-signal detection across every sourceAutomatic enrichment + routing to outreachTeam notifications on high-priority matches

Other Features
One Agent is a start. The stack is the difference.
Pair AI Agents with automatic enrichment, inbound processing, multichannel outreach, and a unified inbox — all on one platform.
Unified Inbox
Email replies, social messages, connection responses, and inbound form submissions — all in one unified inbox. AI flags hot replies. CRM syncs automatically.
Multichannel Outreach
Multichannel sequences that combine email and social networks with smart branching. Run on Leadspicker's own infrastructure. No browser extensions. No account risk.
Data Enrichment
Waterfall data enrichment on every contact. 20+ data points, verified emails and phones, AI-generated custom fields — all from one platform.
 
 
FAQ
Have questions?
We have answers.
Can't find what you're looking for?
Visit Help Center →
Can I build automated, recurring lead lists?
 
Yes. Leadspicker Agents can connect to anything with an API. Pre-built connectors are ready for HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Sheets, Slack, and more. Agents can also work with any REST API endpoint.
What does pricing look like?
 
Subscription-based plans with usage-based pricing for Agent actions. See the pricing page for details.
Can I try it before committing?
 
Yes. Free 7-day trial with no credit card required.
How does waterfall enrichment work?
 
Leadspicker cascades through multiple data providers for each contact. If the first provider doesn't have a verified email or phone number, the next one picks up. This maximizes coverage and minimizes bounces without per-contact credit costs.
Is my data secure?
 
Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Your data is never used to train AI models. For teams with strict compliance or security requirements, we also offer on-premise deployment — your data never leaves your infrastructure.
Do I need to be technical to use it?
 
No. Set up campaigns by describing what you want: Find marketing managers at SaaS companies in Germany and start an email sequence. The chat interface handles the rest.
How is this different from Clay?
 
Clay is strong at enrichment but has no built-in lead discovery or outreach. Leadspicker combines prospecting, enrichment, and multichannel sequences in one platform — with AI Agents that run autonomously. No complex setup.
What data sources can AI Agents scrape?
 
Virtually anything online. LinkedIn, job portals, Google Maps, company websites, industry directories, and custom sources tailored to your business. If it's publicly available, an Agent can find it.
How long does it take to set up?
 
Most teams launch their first AI Agent and start generating leads within 30 minutes. No technical skills needed — describe what you want in plain language using the chat interface.
How is Leadspicker different from Apollo or ZoomInfo?
 
Apollo and ZoomInfo give you large contact databases and tools, but you still have to find leads and run outreach yourself. Leadspicker automates the whole process by finding leads and contacting them for you using AI.

Have questions?
We have answers.
For support or assistance, visit our help center to learn how we can enhance your preconstruction processes.
Visit Help Center →
Is Leadspicker safe to use?
 
Yes, it is. Leadspicker automates more than 95% of LinkedIn actions using its own infrastructure—unlike many other automation tools. We respect the guidelines of the platforms we work with, significantly reducing the risk of any restrictions. Most activities are processed directly through Leadspicker’s infrastructure, not by your own accounts, ensuring a safer and more compliant experience.
What is a robot? 
 
Robot is an AI automation tool—or, if we want to use buzzwords, an “AI agent”—that helps you with lead generation. It can conduct lead research on LinkedIn, track multiple job portals, and monitor other buying intents.
What is Leadspicker’s refund policy?
 
Leadspicker offers refunds on a case-by-case basis. Contact our support team for assistance if you believe you’re eligible for a refund.
What payment methods does Leadspicker accept?
 
Leadspicker accepts all major credit cards for instant subscription activation. Need to pay by invoice? We've got you covered - simply contact us at info@leadspicker.com to arrange invoice payment.
Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
 
Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from the 'Billing' section in your account settings. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the billing cycle.
Can I use Leadspicker for free?
 
Yes, Leadspicker offers a free trial so you can explore the platform's features and see how it fits your needs. The free plan includes access to key functionalities, and you can upgrade anytime to unlock more advanced options.

What counts as a “people search”
A 
people search
 is a single person that the Leadspicker robot has found and evaluated.
If the robot judges the person 
relevant
 (according to your prompt), they appear in 
Contacts
.
If the robot judges the person 
not relevant
, the record is listed only in the robot’s detailed log.
Fair-use limits by subscription plan
Plan
Monthly fair-use allowance
Solo Explorer
20 000 people searches
Growth
80 000 people searches
Scale
500 000 people searches
Unlimited manual uploads
You can upload 
unlimited contacts
 via CSV and send outreach to as many of them as you like.The fair-use limits apply 
only
 to leads that the robots discover and process for you.
Need more capacity?
If you require more people searches than your current plan provides, feel free to contact 
todd.benson@leadspicker.com
 and we’ll tailor a solution for your team.
